title: C# Multiple Choice Questions - LINQ
description: This section of our 1000+ C# multiple choice questions focuses on LINQ in C# Programming Language.

questions.question: Assume 2 columns named Product and Category. How can you sort the list first by Category and then by Product Name using LINQ method syntax?

options.text: var sorted = db.Products.OrderBy(c => c.Category) + ThenBy(n => n.Name);

questions.explanation: In LINQ method syntax, secondary sorting is achieved by chaining the 'ThenBy' method after the initial 'OrderBy' method.

questions.question: Which of the following is an INCORRECT statement about LINQ?

options.text: The core concept behind LINQ is the query
LINQ often uses the foreach loop to execute the query results
LINQ does not require the data source to implement the IEnumerable interface

questions.explanation: For a data source to be used with LINQ to Objects, it MUST implement the IEnumerable or IEnumerable<T> interface.

questions.question: In which namespace is the non-generic 'IEnumerable' interface declared?
questions.explanation: System.Collections contains non-generic interfaces like IEnumerable and IEnumerator. System.Collections.Generic contains their generic counterparts like IEnumerable<T>.

questions.question: Can LINQ be used to query against a standard ADO.NET DataTable?

options.text: Yes, by using the AsEnumerable() extension method
No, LINQ only works with arrays and lists
Yes, but only for reading XML data

questions.explanation: By adding a reference to 'System.Data.DataSetExtensions', you can call 'AsEnumerable()' on a DataTable to perform LINQ queries on its rows.
